name: Psy-Kinetic
headline: A training system that senses when to push—and when to pause.
description: A lightweight XR system combines gaze, physiology and movement to estimate individual state, adjust embodied training intensity, and keep every intervention inside a visible safety boundary.
alt: Participant wearing an XR headset in a closed-loop adaptive training system

name: Growth Resume
headline: Turning scattered experience into a career story.
description: Instead of polishing a document, the system uses reflective dialogue to help students surface meaningful experience, construct a coherent narrative, and turn emerging self-knowledge into the next action.
alt: Student and an intelligent collaborator organizing fragmented experience into a future pathway

name: Cognitive Mobility
headline: Measuring the human state behind every handover.
description: We connect gaze, physiology, behavior and task context to model workload, attention and situational awareness—then translate those states into training, interface and safety decisions.
alt: Human operator with gaze, posture and workload analysis in a control environment

name: Tangible Intelligence
headline: Making intelligent processes visible, understandable and controllable.
description: We turn opaque sensing, reasoning and planning into shared objects and boundaries that people can inspect, question, steer and safely override across interfaces, robots and intelligent environments.
alt: Robotic system combining spatial perception, motion planning and physical action
